newsitem.title: CANADA: IPL rations oil pipeline space for June.
newsitem.headline: IPL rations oil pipeline space for June.

text.p: IPL Energy Inc unit Interprovincial Pipe Line said on Thursday it set June apportionment on its crude oil pipelines to the U.S. Midwest from Canada at one percent.
The apportionment, or amount of oil expected to move on the lines subtracted from shipper nominations, was up from May, when no rationing of space was needed.
The one percent apportionment covered Lines 2 and 3, which extend to Superior, Wisconsin from Edmonton Alberta and Line 13, which runs to Superior from Hardisty, Alberta, downstream from Edmonton.
The three adjacent pipelines carry light, medium, heavy and synthetic crude oil.
IPL said it advised shippers to submit revised nominations for June capacity by 1300 MDT (1500 EDT) on Friday.
The company said no apportionment was needed for June on Line 1, which carries natural gas liquids and petroleum products to Superior from Edmonton. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
